target.title: fix(qa-matrix): CLI scenarios fail safely on stdio pipe errors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QA Matrix CLI scenario runs could crash the parent runner when a stdout or stderr pipe emitted a stream-level error. The runner already collected `data` from both streams, but an `error` event on either stream had no listener and could escape as an unhandled exception.

## Why This Change Was Made

The CLI session now routes stdout and stderr stream errors through the same settled failure path used for child process failures: it clears the timeout, terminates the child process, preserves captured output, and rejects the session with a redacted diagnostic. This keeps the fix scoped to the QA Matrix CLI subprocess runner and does not change CLI arguments, Matrix QA configuration, or scenario semantics.

## User Impact

Developers and CI jobs running QA Matrix scenarios now get a controlled Matrix QA CLI command failure instead of a possible uncaught exception when the parent-side stdout or stderr pipe fails.

## Evidence

- Before the fix, the new regression test failed because emitting `error` on `child.stdout` or `child.stderr` surfaced as an unhandled stream error:

  ```text
  FAIL  |extensions| extensions/qa-matrix/src/runners/contract/scenario-runtime-cli-stream-error.test.ts > Matrix QA CLI runtime stream errors > rejects when stdout emits a stream error
  Error: stdout pipe failed

  FAIL  |extensions| extensions/qa-matrix/src/runners/contract/scenario-runtime-cli-stream-error.test.ts > Matrix QA CLI runtime stream errors > rejects when stderr emits a stream error
  Error: stderr pipe failed
  ```

- After the fix, the QA Matrix CLI runner regression suite passes with the new real-child stream-error coverage:

  ```text
  [test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extensions.config.ts
  The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.

   RUN  v4.1.9 [local path redacted]


   Test Files  2 passed (2)
        Tests  15 passed (15)
     Start at  19:32:05
     Duration  10.35s (transform 5.17s, setup 1.07s, import 8.37s, tests 5.44s, environment 0ms)

  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 22.75s
  ```

- Focused extension lint passed for the changed runner and new regression test:

  ```text
  [plugin-sdk boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [plugin-sdk package boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [qa-channel boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [discord boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [slack boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [whatsapp boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [telegram boundary dts] fresh; skipping
  [plugin-sdk boundary root shims] fresh; skipping
  ```

- Extension package-boundary compile check passed:

  ```text
  preparing plugin-sdk boundary artifacts for 119 plugins
  compile concurrency 4
  skipped 119 fresh plugin compiles
  extension package boundary check passed
  mode: compile
  compiled plugins: 0
  skipped plugins: 119
  canary plugins: 0
  prep elapsed: 236ms
  compile elapsed: 150ms
  elapsed: 740ms
  ```

- The OpenGrep finding was addressed by removing the test-only process-tree `SIGKILL` cleanup and waiting for the production stream-error termination path instead. A source scan of the regression test found no remaining `process.kill(-...)` / `SIGKILL` trigger.
